rules.title: Kalastan · Rules
rules.flowHtml:
Round 1: Roll dice to decide who goes first.

Setup: Deal cards onto the matching board slots.

Production: Starts with the player who first finished production last round. Roll, place all dice of the same face or skip, then the next player does the same, until everyone has used all dice.

  • Skip: burn one die, but you may take any 1 resource.
  • If a player has no dice left, they are skipped automatically.

Production settle: Equal-count dice on a slot cancel each other and leave; then award resources to 1st and 2nd place.

Discard: Check resource hands against the limit; discard until within the hand limit.

Build: Starts with the player who first finished production this round. Take any actions until you end your turn, then the next player; after everyone finishes, go to the next round setup.

(At any time, if any player reaches 15 points, they win immediately and the game ends.)
rules.funcHtml:
Harvest (6)
Build: gain any 2 resources (1 each).
Remote Dice (4)
Your produce turn, before rolling: choose any faces.
Exile (4)
Your produce turn: remove 1 villager of a target on a number slot.
Enhance (2)
Build: enhance 1 die (max 3). Counts as 2 in settle.
Recruit (4)
Build: next produce +2 temp villagers; gone after that produce.
Redraw (2)
Build: draw top of merged deck.
Bandit Raid (4)
Your produce turn: place 2 neutrals on any number slot.
Robbery (4)
Build: take 1 chosen resource from a target if they have ≥1.

Permanent actions (build, unlimited):

Build House
Pay 3W 3S 2I; +1 house and +1 score.
Breed Villagers
Pay wheat = villager count; +1 villager (max 15). Needs 1 free house.
Capacity
Cost 2+2n wood & 2+2n stone (first 2/2, then +2 each time). Expands building, function, and resource tracks together. The Capacity function card is free but still counts.
Market trade
Anytime trade rate based on built Markets (default bank 4:1).

rules.eventHtml:
Each round places 1 event on resource slots 4/5/6; the 10-card deck reshuffles every round. Dispatch triggers resolve on placement; pre-resolve triggers fire after all dice are placed and before resource gains; settle triggers resolve after cancel.

Prisoner’s Dilemma
Settle: after cancel, fewest dice on this slot (ties / 0 allowed) each discard n cards (n = 1st place dice). Happens after normal discard / wish well.
Barren Harvest
Setup marker. Dispatch: move marker to any number slot; marked slot yields no resources.
Resist Barbarians
After produce resolve, before discard: players with ≥2 dice left gain +1 VP in rank order from 1st; reaching 15 ends the game immediately.
Clear Skies
Dispatch: gain any 1 resource (once per dispatch).
Enter the Fray
Setup 6 neutrals. Dispatch: move 1 neutral from here to any number slot.
Mercenaries
Setup 2 mercenary dice. After everyone has placed dice, before produce resolve (resource gains): sole 1st place on this slot rolls and places (ties skip); gain that slot's large share immediately; placing onto a dispatch-trigger event slot also triggers it; then produce resolve.
One Mountain
Settle: 2nd place gets no small share.
Lucky Draw
Setup: face-down top of merged deck. Settle: 1st takes it.
Fisherman’s Profit
Settle: 3rd gains what 1st+2nd gained here (neutrals can fill ranks in 2p).
First Come
Setup 2 of each resource. Dispatch: first player to 5 farmers here takes the stash (once).
rules.backgroundHtml:
You are a baron of the empire—low in rank, with an uncertain future. To win the emperor’s favor, earn glory, and rise among the nobility, you lead your people across the sea to the rumored fertile, unclaimed island of Kalastan.

Your aim is plain: clear the land, gather resources, raise settlements, and turn a thriving domain into courtly praise—promotion, honor, and glory for your house.

But the moment your fleet lands, you discover the island was never reserved for you alone. Other nobles of similar standing, chasing the same climb, have already come ashore.

A silent race to settle begins. You share one island, scarce resources, and equal chances. Chop timber, farm and herd, mine and trade; expand your lands, grow your cities, bargain shrewdly, and shape your sphere of power.

There is no courtesy or coexistence—only strength decides. The first to amass enough prestige wins the emperor’s favor, rises above the other barons, claims Kalastan, and becomes the island’s true ruler.
